hints.title: Grid Partitioning
hints.text: Identify empty cells (value 0) and donor cells (value > 1).

hints.title: Unit Stone Multiplicity
hints.text: Expand each donor cell into individual extra stones, where cell (r, c) appears grid[r][c] - 1 times.

hints.title: Permutation Matching
hints.text: Since there are at most 9 empty cells, generate permutations of donors matched to empty cells to find the minimum Manhattan distance sum.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: k: number of empty cells (at most 9)
complexity.notes: Permutations of at most 9 donor stones.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Grid dimensions are strictly 3x3, so permutation matching is fast and simple.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(k) memory for zero and donor coordinate lists.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Decompose into bipartite permutation matching over small coordinate sets.
